scope: Proposition 5.4 (Probability of irregularity) of the manuscript “Spontaneous magnetization in the quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet” (preprints/Spontaneous-magnetization-in-the-quantum-Heisenberg-ferromagnet-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 271 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8c9083e5eb7a9d6f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix M∗. Under Ip(P), for all 0 < p ≤ p0, all deterministic times t, and all spatial anchors x, PP (t is not regular for x) ≤ δ := CRd p2d + C exp(−cRξ ), ξ = νγ > 0. (5.11) Here R ≥ 1, and the constants may depend on M∗ but are uniform in p ≤ p0, volume, period, grid, pin set and anchor.
